'''The Trickster''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Anmat the Trickster]], a [[boss]] in [[Sacnoth Valley]] and in [[Grothmar Wardowns]] during the [[Against the Charr]] quest.

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (20% chance)
:Halves casting time of Domination Magic spells (20% chance)
:[[Health]] +30

*Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
